description: Download Source Data for Selected Datasets.

descriptionFull.title: User may select a subset of available layers, a bounding region, and temporal bounds and use the configured URL templates to fetch source data for those selections.

name: Data Download

components.name: URL Templates
components.description: List of URL templates to use when submitting data download requests. These only apply to non-vector/query type layers. These may be overridden within individual layer configurations.

object.name: URL Template
object.description: Use any of the following strings in the template: {id}, {min_datetime}, {max_datetime}, {min_lon}, {max_lon}, {min_lat}, {max_lat} and they will be filled in dynamically from the users selection in the application.

object.name: ID Key
object.description: Specify the field name within the layer object to use as the identifier the {id} parameter in the URL template.

object.name: Direct Download
object.description: If checked, the fetched resource is assumed to be a complete file that can be downloaded directly and does not need to be repackaged, such as a zip or NetCDF file.

object.name: File Extension
object.description: If this template does not point to a direct download (see above) it is assumed to return ascii text that will be saved to a file automatically. You may specify the file extension here otherwise txt will be used.
